'''Sidney West Graham''' is a mathematician interested in [[analytic number theory]] and professor at [[Central Michigan University]]. He received his [[Ph.D.]], which was supervised by [[Hugh Montgomery (mathematician)|Hugh Montgomery]], from the [[University of Michigan]] in 1977.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=7249}}</ref> In his Ph.D. thesis he lowered the upper bound for [[Linnik's constant]] to 36 and subsequently reduced the bound further to 20.<ref>{{citation
 | last = Graham | first = S.
 | issue = 2
 | journal = Acta Arithmetica
 | mr = 639625
 | pages = 163–179
 | title = On Linnik's constant
 | url = https://www.infona.pl/resource/bwmeta1.element.bwnjournal-article-aav39i2p163bwm
 | volume = 39
 | year = 1981| doi = 10.4064/aa-39-2-163-179
 | doi-access = free
 }}.</ref>
